newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Ten die in Colombian army clash with rebels.
newsitem.headline: Ten die in Colombian army clash with rebels.

text.p: At least nine leftist rebels and one soldier died in heavy fighting in northeast Colombia over the weekend, regional army commander Gen. Rafael Hernandez said on Sunday.

Fighting between troops and the Revolutionary Armed Forces of Colombia (FARC), Latin America's oldest and largest guerrilla force, began near the town of Tame in Arauca province shortly before midday Saturday and continued through Sunday, Hernandez said.
He said five soldiers were wounded in the clash, two of them seriously.
The latest killings took the death toll in politically related bloodshed to more than 55 since Thursday.

One of the worst single incidents took place late on Friday near the town of Vegachi, in northwest Antioquia province. Eight men were dragged from their homes and executed by a 20-strong gang of suspected right-wing paramilitaries, authorities said.
